svg.title: NormativeSubject nullability example with conditions A through E, composite tree with a divider to resolved atomic requirements
svg.desc: Left side, composite requirement: a gray context grouping bullet branches to three children: a teal lowest-level normative bullet using Condition A, a coral condition grouping bullet starting with When Condition B and Condition C, and a teal lowest-level normative bullet for the fallback case. The condition grouping bullet branches to two more teal lowest-level normative bullets using Condition D and Condition E. Right side, separated by a divider, four purple boxes show the fully resolved atomic requirement for each leaf.
